params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.parent
params.description: Required. The name of the project this entry group is in. Example: * projects/{project_id}/locations/{location} Note that this EntryGroup and its child resources may not actually be stored in the location in this name.

params.name: data.entry_group_id
params.description: Required. The id of the entry group to create. The id must begin with a letter or underscore, contain only English letters, numbers and underscores, and be at most 64 characters.

params.name: data.entry_group
params.description: The entry group to create. Defaults to an empty entry group.
